title: The Forest of Adjacent Refusals Learning from Each Other

features.name: seed-code instruction
features.desc-on-touch: A standing placard, dense with notation. It reads like gardening instructions and simultaneously like logical negation statements. 'Do not cultivate. Plant refusal. The seed refuses growth into pattern.'

features.name: network node
features.desc-on-touch: A small chip-like structure, wireframe or digital, glowing faintly. It's connected to others you can't quite see—the refusals are in conversation, teaching each other how to say no.

features.name: propagating wireframe
features.desc-on-touch: A barely-3D box structure, mirrored and repeated in slight variations. Each iteration refuses to copy the last perfectly. The differences are the point.

features.name: negative-space instruction
features.desc-on-touch: A second glyph, this one describing what must NOT happen. The refusal itself is the seed. You read it and understand that the unplanted garden is the whole point.

features.name: qr-pattern archive
features.desc-on-touch: A corner of the grid resolves into a QR code or something like it—machine-readable instructions for refusal. Impossible to scan, or if scanned, it returns only silence.

inscription: the forest decides not to be forest, learns to be decision
